notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b003:l002: Eighteen days now vs70days284,48days12 all retained, not harmonized or added into a guessed campaign duration.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b003:l004: No Muslim companions source religious grouping, not claim no Muslims exist locally today.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b003:l006: Милек not in local Yudakhin; primary same2010 witness parallel Кытай милек биздер аз confirms many/few contrast. Render multitude, no invented million count. Singular she alone retained despite two girls around it.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b003:l007: Rhetorical what done against God in suffering context, no invented crime.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b003:l015: Zhyldyz printed capitalized place, not falling star here; sky star right8 distinct.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b003:l016: Dog-like fighting metaphor retained, not modern aerial dogfight.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b003:l018: Oguz-Ashuu/Tai-Ashuu passes and Kunos/Tekes/Uch-Aral destinations retained, no modern map claim.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b003:l024: Bows explicit, not rifles substituted; exchanged shots12 unspecified projectile left broad. Source distances too far for spears23.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b003:l025: Parenthetical narrator aside about skilled swine Kongurbay kept as narrative verse, not apparatus exclusion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b003:l028: Telkyzyl is Kardygach’s horse; breast shot33 refers mount who dies34, not invented bodily wound to maiden. Kalcha epithet of Kongurbay in30, not new allied general.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b003:l035: Kardygach death impending conditional, not actual death; Saikal rescues her next column.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b004:l001: Primary Yudakhin кадиктүү sense2 strong/mighty, not suspicious or untrustworthy in praising Saikal.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b004:l004: Relative gift clause: Kuyaly daughter of Kaip freely bestowed Surkyzyl; Saikal now mounts Kardygach on it. Original gift recipient not specified. Revised English avoids implying Kuyaly originally gave horse directly to Kardygach. No horse breeding history invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b004:l008: Star eclipsed in sky source omen/image retained, not literal validated astronomy or restored fallen star.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b004:l012: Remaining alive, no unprinted barely inserted. Fire/upward escape image13 retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b004:l017: Аянып conserving strength, no walking stick invented in following таянып shelter/support phrase.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b004:l020: Piebald stallion burden and night-only travel literal; no number of baggage loads added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b004:l023: Inscription on black stone/name Ala-Aigyr and Saikal claimed in source; not verified modern historical monument. Ушу күндөн ошо күн reordered conventional from that day to this to express continuing commemoration, exact raw order retained in evidence.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b004:l026: Кымбат жоо costly foe, source hardship irony, not beloved enemy. Саат I primary hindrance/trouble, not clock hour.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b004:l031: Impending forced marriage in enemy captivity, not already completed marriage or added explicit sexual detail.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b004:l032: Golden forelock/tasseled belt epithets lead Almambet, not actual hair color independently asserted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0285:b004:l036: Finest of60 and formidable among40 source groups both retained, no arithmetic correction.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b003:l002: Primary Yudakhin заңгел enormous rock/crag; split cliffs literal, not propername Zangel.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b003:l005: Almambet travels by night, not day; Bakai skirts foothills, distinct motions retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b003:l008: Kakan people’s grave trouble compressed mission object, no specific rescue report added before scouts see tracks.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b003:l010: Moonlike Sary-Talaa named place and comparison retained, not modern moonlit-night assertion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b003:l012: Dead horses’ protruding teeth and dead warriors’ mustaches source details preserved without added gore.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b003:l016: Four dawn/light/star verses all retained; stars departing sky not meteor shower invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b003:l024: Кемеге hearth pit, hoof tracks compared pits, not actual dug siege trenches.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b003:l029: Bakai infers from tracks; бейм seems repeated31/36/37/38 retained as inference not omniscient certainty.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b003:l030: Coming in numbers against lives literal compressed threat, no extra casualty count.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b003:l038: Four livestock kinds conventional collective, no enumeration of unprinted species.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b003:l039: Primary Yudakhin сары изине чөп салган куугун-сүргүн relentless pursuit, not planting grass on yellow footprints. Hot on trail idiom, not physical temperature.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b004:l001: Аяр master of hidden arts, Almambet weather-working next14; not ordinary cautiousness alone.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b004:l013: Primary Yudakhin exact ала канчык шыбыргак fine rain turning to snow with gusts. No literal piebald bitch appears. Magical weather source claim, not practical method instructions.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b004:l017: Primary куй II disposition/character, күндүн куюн бузултуп жайлап жүрөт Алмамбет exact weather-sorcery formula; weather’s temper spoiled, not sun’s well polluted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b004:l020: Sixty Chinese and countless governors repeated23 where60captured; source ambiguous escape/recapture grouping not silently fixed to6000. Kongurbay escapes22, no fabricated capture of him.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b004:l025: 1000wrestlers led by governor captured by Bakai, then all slain by Almambet as sacrifices, source actions retained; no extra procedure/gore added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b004:l031: Two distressed warrior maidens rescued, not literally insane diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b004:l036: Manas supplied to clarify whose sister Kardygach is;284:3:29–33 explicitly same mother bears Manas and Kardygach. Avoid misleading antecedent Karacha immediately preceding.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0286:b004:l037: Zhelpinish at world’s end, Zharmanas named recipient in marriage context; negative people epithet retained, no modern ethnicity invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b003:l001: Repeated one son lion/one daughter warrior closes mother’s speech; all repetitions retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b003:l007: Kanykei still calls own son little brother, concealment in text, not actual different genealogy.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b003:l013: Lattice wall, curtain, bed spatial sequence retained, no modern house plan invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b003:l017: Шай spiritual patron, not tea; Chyiyrdy mother of Manas explicitly19.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b003:l021: Age95 repeats36, not deduplicated or corrected from other versions.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b003:l022: Quail-like stoop literal simile, not exact posture diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b003:l028: Pus-filled eyes/rattling chest/trembling twelve bones literal source infirmity; no extra clinical diagnosis. Twelve-body-part convention retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b003:l032: Neither in grave nor counted among living rhetorical debility, not literal undead resurrection.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b003:l035: Дүйнө бок coarse shit wording retained, not softened or removed as annotation despite closing parenthesis printed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b004:l001: Takes her exactly by forearm, not forcefully striking old woman.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b004:l004: Урмеке sacred mother primary Seytek1991glossary352; меке7 maternal object of reverence/refuge Yudakhin, not geographic Mecca.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b004:l010: Куда young in-law masks actual grandson because Semetey’s parentage is hidden; no correction to grandson in dialogue. English in-law intentionally broad marriage kinship, not son-in-law specifically.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b004:l014: Улар snowcock lament simile, no literal transformation into bird asserted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b004:l019: Deep repeated coughing vs sharp repeated coughing21, both preserved; no dosage/medical advice introduced.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b004:l024: Араң explicitly barely managed to rise; retained here unlike unprinted barely in prior survival formulas.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b004:l026: Куу eyes dry/worn, кадыры жетик dignity/honor; literal dry eyes rendered, no new tears supplied while wiping.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b004:l028: Эт бышым traditional interval meat takes to cook, not converted to guessed minutes. Long patient gaze retained29.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b004:l031: Printed image Коё берди, cached normalized extraction Ко¸ берди. English inceptive speech began introducing following plea, no silent modification of raw/source evidence or literal release of captive.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b004:l034: Kanykei addressed as foal/tireless steed, six-month ride/sixty mature years extended metaphor, not actual aging zoological assertion. Teeth-wearing/aging36 both retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0287:b004:l038: Primary дулдул II tireless steed, from legendary Ali mount but figurative here; black white-blazed horse epithet preserved, not new named animal. Speech continues288.
